_doc: The names rule sets share for what a part mounts by and what it does, so one piece of code can read any of them: a motor, a board, a screw. A set with "part" uses these names directly. An older set keeps its own names and says which is which in "interface". Read by cad rules check and cad rules draw.

body_shape.says: the body's outline, seen from the mounting face

body_width.says: a square frame's side, or a box's long side

body_top.says: what stands above the mounting face, beside the shaft

body_corner.says: how far each corner of a square frame is cut back

boss_diameter.says: the pilot boss round the shaft

boss_height.says: how far the boss stands proud of the mounting face

boss_offset.says: the shaft's distance from the body's centre, where it isn't central

shaft_length.says: from the mounting face to the shaft's tip

shaft_flat_across.says: across the shaft at its flat, or across two flats

shaft_flat_length.says: the flat's length, back from the tip

horn_screw.says: the thread that holds a servo's horn

mount_pattern.says: four holes on a square, or two

mount_hole_depth.says: the thread's depth in the part

mount_ear_radius.says: the radius of an ear round its hole

mount_tab_length.says: a servo's tabs, end to end

cable_width.says: room for the wires, across the part

cable_reach.says: the wire housing's far side, from the body's centre

screw_clearance.says: a clearance hole for the screw

rated_voltage.says: the voltage its figures are given at

rated_current.says: amps per phase, or the most it works at

pull_in_torque.says: what a geared stepper starts against

friction_torque.says: friction in a built-in gearbox, at the output

torque_limit.says: the most its gearbox should see

no_load_speed.says: free running at the rated voltage

kv.says: a brushless motor's speed per volt

temperature_rise.says: the case above the room, at rated current

radial_load.says: the most sideways load on the shaft
